newsitem.title: USA: U.S. wheat weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. wheat weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.

text.p: USDA wheat export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Net sales of 968,100 metric tons (MT) were two-thirds above the week earlier. Major increases were recorded for Pakistan (350,000 MT), unknown destinations (78,800 MT), Turkey (75,300 MT), South Korea (60,800 MT), Egypt (55,000 MT), Japan (40,600 MT), and Peru (40,000 MT).

Exports of 345,400 MT were 19 percent below the prior week and 12 percent under the 4-week average. The primary destinations were Jordan (80,300 MT), Italy (46,800 MT), Egypt (35,000 MT), Mexico (28,300 MT), Taiwan (26,900 MT), and Belgium (26,800 MT).
